# ARADMANAMNAOON

> Portfolio and technical writing by Seyyed Arad Hosseini Moghaddam, a data scientist and AI engineer working across data science, deep learning, computer vision and medical imaging, NLP and language models, LLM fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic AI, MLOps, and software and cross-platform mobile development.

## Primary pages
- [Portfolio](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/): Profile, skills, selected work, writing, and contact.
- [Projects](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/projects/): Selected projects across AI, machine learning, language technologies, and software development.
- [Technical blog](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/blog/): First-hand experiments, debugging stories, project breakdowns, and engineering lessons.

## Areas of work
- Data science and applied analytics.
- Deep learning and model training from scratch.
- Computer vision and medical imaging.
- Natural language processing and language models.
- LLM fine-tuning, including LoRA and QLoRA.
- Retrieval-augmented generation and agentic AI.
- MLOps and AI application engineering.
- Software development and Flutter apps for Android and iOS.

## Featured technical writing
- [How to Design an Evaluatable Multi-Agent RAG System with LangGraph](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/blog/evaluatable-multi-agent-rag-langgraph/): Workflow design, evidence handling, bounded reflection, and evaluation for multi-agent RAG systems.
- [A Hugging Face Gradient Accumulation Bug Almost Ruined My 19-Hour NLLB Training Run](https://aradmanamnaoon.github.io/blog/hugging-face-nllb-gradient-accumulation-bug/): Debugging loss scaling while fine-tuning NLLB-200 for English↔Persian translation.
